concerns.text: T005f (Update spec/research for resolution limits) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T009 (Create research.md). T009 itself depends on T003. However, T005f is listed as a dependency for T054 and T013. T013 (Preprocessing) is in Phase 3. The dependency chain T009 -> T005f -> T013 is valid, but T005f is marked [P] despite being a sequential update task that must complete before T013 can run. More critically, T005g (Implement metadata schema extension) depends on T006a (Create base data contracts), but T006a is in Phase 2. T005g is in Phase 1. This is a producer-before-consumer violation: T005g consumes T006a, but T005g is scheduled before T006a.

T005g (Implement metadata schema extension) depends on T006a (Create base data contracts). T005g is in Phase 1, T006a is in Phase 2. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' rule. T006a must precede T005g.

T005i (Implement utility for confidence intervals) depends on T005g and T022. T022 (Texture feature extraction) is in Phase 4. T005i is in Phase 1. This is a consumer-before-producer violation: T005i consumes T022, but T005i is scheduled before T022.

T005d (Validate dataset size assumption) depends on T009 and T005. T005 (Implement synthetic generator) is in Phase 2. T005d is in Phase 1. This is a consumer-before-producer violation: T005d consumes T005, but T005d is scheduled before T005.
